final_prompt: Edit this pixel-art game background. Remove BOTH hooded characters entirely: pink character at left and purple character at right. Replace only those character areas with blue brick wall and matching small graffiti paint splashes, consistent pixel art. Preserve the excellent central "MOB BR" graffiti lettering exactly: same shapes, placement, cyan and yellow colors, magenta/navy shadows, crown and stars. Preserve all other background environment, framing and crisp pixel art. No characters, no people, no creatures, no faces anywhere. Keep original dimensions and opaque background.
original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished landscape background illustration for the Japanese cartoon training / battle royale game MOB BR. Create authentic crisp pixel art, as if a 480x270 arcade background enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels: visible square pixel clusters, hard stepped contours, limited color palette, no smooth vector gradients. An exuberant cartoon street graffiti mural on a blue urban brick wall. Exact central graffiti text: "MOB BR" (M O B, space, B R), large legible playful chunky yellow and cyan letters with dark navy outline, magenta shadow, paint splashes and pixel stars. Cute small hooded MOB mascots at the two edges: pink hood and purple hood, black featureless faces with two round glowing yellow eyes, compact chibi bodies. Sporty upbeat game clubhouse atmosphere. Wide balanced composition; logo centered upper-middle, calmer blue wall at bottom for game interface. Saturated cyan, deep blue, pink, warm yellow accents. Flat frontal view. Pixel art throughout including lettering, no photorealism, no smooth 3D, no other text, no watermarks. This is background artwork only, no buttons, no UI panels.
